resources.string: Pasiva
Puedes seleccionar una opción de equipamiento adicional.
Pasiva
**STRATEGIC GAMBIT.** Selecciona un Operativo enemigo. Hasta el final del turno, cuando un aliado **RATLING** esté disparando a ese Operativo enemigo con un Rifle, esa arma gana la regla Lethal 5+.
Pasiva

Una vez por turno, después de que un Operativo enemigo haga una acción en la que se mueva o sea puesto, puedes interrumpirlo para usar esta regla. Si lo haces, cada aliado **RATLING** (excluyendo **OGRYN** y **BULLGRYN**) a 6\" de este Operativo y a 2\" de ese Operativo enemigo puede hacer una accion gratis de **Dash** o **Fall Back** en el orden de tu eleccion (escoje por separado para cada uno), pero no puede moverse mas de 3\" durante esa accion. Y en cualquier caso, ninguno puede terminar ese movimiento a 2\" de un Operativo enemigo a menos que no sea visible para cada Operativo enemigo cuando termine ese movimiento (si esto no es posible para un Operativo, no se puede mover).
Pasiva
Este Operativo no puede hacer ninguna otra acción que no sea **Cargar, Dash, Fall Back, Combatir** y **Reposición**. No puede usar armas que no estén en su tarjeta de personaje.
Pasiva

Si este Operativo tiene un Slabshield, tiene una estadística de Salvación de 3+, si tiene un Brute Shield, cuando esté combatiendo o retaleando, cada uno de tus bloqueos puede ser usado para bloquear dos resultados sin resolver (en lugar de uno).
Pasiva

Cuando tu oponente esté seleccionando un objetivo válido, si este Operativo está en **Conceal**, no puede usar terreno ligero para cubrirse. Mientras esto permite que sea seleccionado como objetivo válido (asumiendo que sea visible), no remueve salvaciones de cobertura (en caso de que tenga alguna).
Pasiva
Debes gastar 1 AP adicional para que este Operativo haga una acción de **Pick up Marker** o acciones de misión (excluyendo **Operate Hatch**).
Pasiva
Cuando este Operativo termina un movimiento durante la acción de **Cargar**, puedes infligir D3+1 heridas a un enemigo dentro de su rango de control.
Pasiva

Cuando pongas tu equipamiento durante la batalla, puedes poner dos de tus marcadores Tripwire completamente dentro de tu territorio y a más de 2\" de otros marcadores, puntos de acceso o terreno accesible. La primera vez que este marcador está dentro del rango de control de un Operativo enemigo remueve ese marcador, sustrae 1 de la estadística de APL de este Operativo hasta el final de su próxima activación y esa acción termina (aunque no se haya completado), si no puede ser puesto en esa ubicación, mueve el Operativo la mínima cantidad posible para que pueda ser puesto en el campo.
Pasiva

Una Mina seleccionada del equipamiento universal inflige 2D3+3 de daño ahora, y aliados **RATLING** (excluyendo **OGRYN** y **BULLGRYN**) son ignorados para los efectos de tu mina (no pueden recibir daño de la Mina). Esto toma precedencia sobre las reglas normales de la Mina.
Pasiva

Este Operativo puede hacer la acción de **Cargar** mientras tenga una orden de **Conceal**. Si lo hace durante su activación, hasta el final de esa activación, añade 1 a la estadística de Atk de su Combat Knife y esa arma de Melee gana la regla Brutal.
Pasiva
Cuando este Operativo esté retaleando mientras terreno ligero o pesado esté dentro de su rango de control, tú resuelves el primer dado de ataque (defensor en lugar de atacante).
1AP

Selecciona un punto en una pieza de terreno, ese punto debe ser visible y a 6\" de este Operativo. Remueve este Operativo del campo y ponlo completamente a 6\" horizontalmente de ese punto, no dentro del rango de control de un Operativo enemigo, y con ese punto seleccionado aún siendo visible para el.\n\n
Esta acción es tratada como una **Reposicion**. Este Operativo no puede hacer esta acción mientras esté dentro del rango de control de un Operativo enemigo o durante una activación en la que haya hecho las acciones **Cargar, Fall Back** o **Disparar** (o viceversa).
Pasiva
Whenever this operative is climbing up, you can treat the vertical distance as 2\" (regardless of how far the operative actually moves vertically).
1AP

Until the start of this operatives next activation, whenever it is shooting, enemy operatives cannot be obscured and the stationary profile of this operatives suppressed sniper rifle has the Lethal 5+ weapon rule.\n\n This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.
Pasiva

Once per turning point, after an enemy operative performs an action, you can interrupt and perform a free **Dash** action with this operative. Note this operative cannot use the Scarper faction rule (it has this rule instead).
1AP

**SUPPORT.** Select one enemy operative visible to this operative. Once during this turning point, when a friendly **RATLING** operative within 3\" of this operative is shooting that enemy operative, you can use this effect. If you do:
Pasiva
Once during each of this operatives activations, it can perform the **Pick Up Marker**, **Place Marker** or a mission action for 1 less AP.
Pasiva
If you select an Ammo Cache from universal equipment, you can set up an additional Ammo Cache marker.
1AP

**SUPPORT**. Select one other friendly **RATLING** operative visible to and within 6\" of this operative. Until the end of its next activation, add 1 to that operatives APL stat.\n\n This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.
Despite their small stature, Ratlings are fleet of foot, using their speed and agility to outpace and evade their foes.

After each enemy operative’s activation, before the next operative is activated, one friendly **RATLING** operative (excluding **BULLGRYN**, **OGRYN** and **SNEAK**) can perform a free **Dash** action, but it cannot end that move within 3\" of an enemy operative unless it is not visible to every enemy operative when it ends that move.\n \n Each friendly operative can only do this once per turning point, and cannot do so after the final activation of the turning point.

Ratlings have a well-earned reputation for greed. No field kitchen is safe from their thieving hands. It is not uncommon for a Ratling to settle a rumbling belly with a link of freshly liberated protein reconstitution prior to firing a killing shot.

Once per turning point, when a friendly **RATLING** operative is shooting with a rifle and you have rolled your attack dice, you can use this rule. If you do, improve the Hit stat of its rifle by 1 until the end of that sequence.
Superstitious by nature, many Ratlings hold back a lucky round with which to target a large or powerful foe, kill an enemy that is wronged them, or make a particularly tricky shot.

Once per turning point, when a friendly **RATLING** operative is shooting with a rifle and you have rolled your attack dice, you can use this rule. If you do, that weapon has the Severe weapon rule until the end of that sequence.
Ratlings are notoriously light-fingered, capable of seizing intel and equipment from under the noses of their foes.

At the end of the Select Operatives step, roll one D3. If the result is:
 
 • 1, you lose 1CP.
 
 • 2, you gain 1CP.
 
 • 3, your opponent loses 1CP.

Such is the size of Ogryns that precious little standard-issue armour fits their bulky frames. Most are outfitted instead with makeshift plates forged from thick armour and tank tracks ripped from destroyed vehicles.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly **RATLING BULLGRYN** or friendly **RATLING OGRYN** operative, defence dice results of 5+ are critical successes.
Ratlings spend hours or even days selecting vantage points, ensuring that any position they take affords them effective cover and clear sight lines from which to pick off the advancing foe.
Whenever a friendly **RATLING** operative is more than 6\" from enemy operatives and within 1\" of Heavy terrain, the stationary profile of its rifle (if any) has the Silent weapon rule.
It is said that a Ratling can put a bullet through an opponent’s eye socket from more than a thousand yards away.

Whenever a friendly **RATLING** operative is shooting an enemy operative more than 6\" from it, if that friendly operative has not performed the **Charge, Fall Back** or **Reposition** action during the activation, or if it is a counteraction, its rifle (if any) has the Balanced weapon rule. Note that operative is not restricted from performing those actions after shooting.
Small of stature and well used to hiding from larger foes, Ratlings use terrain and shadow to their advantage.

Whenever a friendly **RATLING** operative (excluding **OGRYN** or **BULLGRYN**) has a **Conceal** order and is in cover, it cannot be selected as a valid target, taking precedence over all other rules (e.g. Seek, Vantage terrain) except being within 2\".
Ogryns are brutish, muscular soldiers who are most effective when deployed as close combat troops.

Whenever a friendly **RATLING BULLGRYN** or friendly **RATLING OGRYN** operative within your opponents territory or within 3\" of an objective marker is shooting, fighting or retaliating, its weapons have the Balanced weapon rule.
Lacking physical strength and fortitude, Ratlings rely upon their reflexes and natural instincts to save themselves from harm.

Use this firefight ploy when an enemy operative is shooting against or fighting against a friendly **RATLING** operative (excluding **OGRYN** or **BULLGRYN**) and you are allocating a dice to block. If it is a normal success, it can block one unresolved critical success; if it is a critical success, it can block two unresolved successes (normal or critical).
Ratlings can pick out enemies in the thick of even the most chaotic battles. Many soldiers have been saved from certain death by their precise fire.

Use this firefight ploy when a friendly **RATLING** operative is performing the **Shoot** action with a rifle and you are selecting a valid target. Having other friendly **RATLING** operatives within an enemy operatives control range does not prevent that enemy operative from being selected.
Their diminutive size and gift for stealth makes Ratlings naturally skilled thieves.

Use this firefight ploy during a friendly **RATLING** operatives activation (excluding **OGRYN** or **BULLGRYN**). Until the end of that activation, that operative does not have to control a marker to perform the **Pick Up Marker** or mission actions that usually require this (this takes precedence over that actions conditions – it only needs to contest the marker), and having an enemy operative within its control range doesn’t prevent it from doing so.
A sniper is vulnerable once their position has been detected, thus Ratling sharpshooters are constantly sneaking away

Use this firefight ploy after a friendly **RATLING** operative that has an **Engage** order performs the **Shoot** action with a rifle. If it is more than 3\" from enemy operatives, or not visible to every enemy operative, you can change its order to **Conceal**.
